Customer portal
===============

### Registration eligibility

Scope: Customer portal.

Registration requires all the following conditions.

The user provides a valid email address.

The user provides a password of at least 12 characters.

The user accepts the terms of service.

Missing any required condition prevents registration.

Invited company users do not need to provide a password; the other registration conditions still apply.

## Registration activation

Scope: Customer portal.

Registration activation requires either of the following confirmations.

The user follows the email confirmation link.

The user enters a confirmation code supplied by support.

Either confirmation is enough to satisfy this confirmation requirement; it does not guarantee successful activation.

## Password reset

Scope: Customer portal.

Password reset requires all the following conditions.

The account has a verified email address.

The account is active.

An inactive account cannot reset its password.
